SELECT partyname, presidentname, yearborn
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.partyname,
        p.presidentname,
        p.yearborn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.partyname
            ORDER BY p.yearborn ASC, p.presidentname ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM President p
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY partyname;

        p.presidentname,
        p.yearborn,

            PARTITION BY p.partyname
            ORDER BY p.yearborn ASC, p.presidentname ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM President p
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY partyname

  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total_spending
  FROM Ecommerce
  GROUP BY CustomerID

SELECT CustomerID,
       (second_order_date - first_order_date) AS days_between_first_and_second_order
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS first_order_date,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) AS second_order_date
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerID,
               OrderDate,
               OrderID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
        FROM Ecommerce
    ) t
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) s
WHERE second_order_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH ordered AS (

    CustomerID,
    OrderDate,
    OrderID,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
  FROM Ecommerce
),
first_two AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) AS second_order_date

  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
  CustomerID,
  second_order_date - first_order_date AS days_between_first_and_second_order
FROM first_two
ORDER BY CustomerID;

  first_order_date,
  second_order_date,
  (second_order_date - first_order_date) AS days_between_first_and_second_orders
FROM (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    OrderDate AS first_order_date,
    LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS second_order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID) AS order_count
  FROM Ecommerce
) t
WHERE order_count >= 2
  AND rn = 1
ORDER BY CustomerID;

SELECT CustomerID,
       (second_order_date - first_order_date) AS days_between_first_and_second_order
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS first_order_date,
           MIN(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) AS second_order_date
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerID,
               OrderDate,
               OrderID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
        FROM Ecommerce
    ) t
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) s
WHERE second_order_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  CustomerID,
  first_order_date,
  second_order_date,
  second_order_date - first_order_date AS days_between_first_and_second
FROM (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    OrderDate AS first_order_date,
    LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS second_order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID) AS order_count
  FROM Ecommerce
) t
WHERE order_count >= 2
  AND rn = 1;

WITH UniqueOrders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
    FROM UniqueOrders
)
SELECT
    o1.CustomerID,
    o2.OrderDate - o1.OrderDate AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders o1
JOIN RankedOrders o2 ON o1.CustomerID = o2.CustomerID AND o1.rn = 1 AND o2.rn = 2;

)

SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    second_order_date - OrderDate AS days_between
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS second_order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
        FROM Ecommerce
    ) orders
) ranked_orders
WHERE rn = 1 AND second_order_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM Ecommerce
)
SELECT
    o1.CustomerID,
    (o2.OrderDate - o1.OrderDate) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders o1
JOIN RankedOrders o2 ON o1.CustomerID = o2.CustomerID AND o2.rn = 2
WHERE o1.rn = 1;

WITH RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM Ecommerce
)
SELECT

WITH DistinctOrders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID, 
        OrderDate,
        LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS second_order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM DistinctOrders
)
SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    (second_order_date - OrderDate) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn = 1 AND second_order_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
        SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM Ecommerce
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OrderDate) = 2024
    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM')
)
SELECT
    month,
    total_revenue,
    total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS revenue_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        Category,
        ProductName,
        SUM(Revenue) AS TotalRevenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC, ProductName ASC) AS rank
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY Category, ProductName
)
SELECT Category, ProductName, TotalRevenue
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY Category, TotalRevenue DESC, ProductName ASC;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate) AS month_start,
        SUM(Revenue) AS monthly_total
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate)
),
mom_calc AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        monthly_total,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS change_from_previous_month
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    monthly_total,
    change_from_previous_month
FROM mom_calc
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_start) = 2024
ORDER BY month_start;

SELECT

    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce

WITH UniqueOrders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate
    FROM Ecommerce
),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM UniqueOrders
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY CustomerID
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;
sql:

),
RankedOrders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        OrderDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
    FROM UniqueOrders
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS days_between
FROM RankedOrders
WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY CustomerID
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    SUM(Revenue) AS monthly_total,
    SUM(Revenue) - LAG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (ORDER BY TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM')) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM Ecommerce
WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate <= '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month;

    TO_CHAR(OrderDate, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    SUM(Revenue) AS monthly_total,

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate) AS month_date,
        SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM Ecommerce
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate)
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(month_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    total_revenue,
    total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS revenue_change
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_date) = 2024
ORDER BY month_date;

    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate, OrderID) AS rn
  FROM Ecommerce

    CustomerID,

  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)

  CustomerID,
  first_order_date,
  second_order_date,
  (second_order_date - first_order_date) AS days_between
FROM agg;

  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total_spending
  FROM Ecommerce
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
percentile AS (
  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spending) AS p95

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
  FROM Ecommerce
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN OrderDate END) AS FirstOrderDate,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) AS SecondOrderDate,
    COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
  CustomerID,
  (SecondOrderDate - FirstOrderDate) AS DaysBetweenFirstAndSecondOrder
FROM agg
WHERE OrderCount >= 2;

  SELECT
    Category,
    ProductName,
    SUM(Revenue) AS TotalRevenue
  FROM Ecommerce
  GROUP BY Category, ProductName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT

)

WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY Category, TotalRevenue DESC, ProductName ASC;

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total_spending
  FROM Ecommerce
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spending) AS p95
  FROM customer_totals
)

WHERE ct.total_spending > t.p95
ORDER BY ct.total_spending DESC;

  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate ASC, OrderID ASC) AS rn
  FROM Ecommerce
),

    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN OrderDate END) AS SecondOrderDate,
    COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)

  CustomerID,
  (SecondOrderDate - FirstOrderDate) AS DaysBetweenFirstAndSecondOrder
FROM agg

WITH DecadeCounts AS (
    SELECT (YearBorn / 10) * 10 AS Decade,
           COUNT(*) AS PresidentCount
    FROM President
    GROUP BY (YearBorn / 10) * 10
)
SELECT Decade, PresidentCount
FROM DecadeCounts
ORDER BY Decade;

SELECT
    OrderDate,
    SUM(Revenue) AS DailyRevenue,
    AVG(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (
        ORDER BY OrderDate
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS MovingAvg7Day
FROM Ecommerce
GROUP BY OrderDate
ORDER BY OrderDate;
